title: Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Terms: Each Order a Separate Holding
content:
**Clause 1 — Number of orders.** A customer may place any number of Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay orders. No maximum is set on how many orders one customer may hold under this clause.

**Clause 2 — One order, one holding.** Each order is its own holding, with its own order reference, its own value, its own destination, its own delivery and its own refund. An order covers one product, one destination (a phone number, a meter number or a biller account) and one value.

**Clause 3 — No merging or netting.** Orders are never merged with one another and never netted against one another.

**Clause 4 — What bounds the orders.** What bounds a customer's orders are the order caps of Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay, which count orders and order value per product.

**Clause 5 — Personal sending limits.** The value of a Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay order never counts toward the customer's personal sending limits.

## The clauses applied (hypothetical customer)

A customer holds three Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay orders: a Paloma Airtime Top-Up order that has been delivered, a Paloma Data Bundle order that has failed, and a Paloma Bill Pay Utilities payment that is still processing.

| Question | Answer under the clauses |
|---|---|
| Is the failed Paloma Data Bundle order handled with the delivered top-up as one amount? | No. Each order has its own delivery and its own refund (Clause 2), and orders are never merged or netted (Clause 3). |
| Does the refund of the failed order reduce what the customer paid for the bill payment? | No. Orders are never netted (Clause 3). |
| Do the three order values use up part of the customer's personal sending limits? | No (Clause 5). |
| May the customer place a fourth order? | Clause 1 sets no maximum on the number of orders; the order caps of Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay are what bound it (Clause 4). |

## Basis Q&A

**Two orders to the same phone number — one record or two?** Two. Each order keeps its own reference, value, delivery and refund, even when the destination is the same.

**Does the value of a large Paloma Bill Pay School Fees payment count toward the customer's personal sending limits?** No. Clause 5 applies to every Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay order, whatever its product or value.
